## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, inventory exports, hostnames or personal screenshots are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated (`docs/configuration.md` for new variables).
- [ ] Tests use disposable data and do not affect an existing installation.
- [ ] Catalog entries are verified against the live project (`docs/catalog.md`).

Merging to main publishes nothing. Images and releases are built only from version tags.
